_doc: Source-purification spec for 'THE AGE BEATERS and Their Universal Currency for Immortality' (Wallach/Ma Lan). Built SESSION-43. Chunk A = running-header/footer strip + mechanical OCR categories; spell-suspects + digit_in_word verified against page scans come in later chunks. Book uses 2-page-spread screenshots (254 shots) so PRINTED page numbers run 1-481. The header is title-case 'Immortality' (scanner-blind, like DDDL's DEAD DOCTORS): verso '<n> Immortality', recto 'Immortality <n>', 9 OCR-doubled '<n> Immortality Immortality <m>', and 13 page-number-dropped bare 'Immortality'. The 47 bare-number lines are TABLE + INDEX data (verified against context) NOT footers, so drop_line_numbers stays empty. Front matter (title/copyright/TOC/roman-numbered intro, <=L609) is protected, keeping its 6 title 'Immortality' + 5 roman headers. [Chunk-A reflow: 61 entries / 66 findings. DEFERRED 1: Lao-Tzu (L18508) wraps across a stripped running header + messy blanks -> handle against post-strip residual.] CHUNK B (2026-07-23): pp.378-379 two-column de-interleave of the ORAC/'Antioxidants:' section, verified against Screenshot (202).png — see the replacements[] entry. NOTE: this spec is APPLY-ONCE, not idempotent; a dry run aborts on Chunk A's spent strip_running counts. Entries are the historical audit trail, not a re-runnable script. CHUNK C (2026-07-23): pp.380-381, the CONTINUATION of the ORAC value table. Screenshot (203) is two-column; OCR emitted all 43 NAMES as one block and the NUMBERS as a separate block, dropping 18 of the left column's 23 values outright. Rebuilt as 43 'name value' rows from the page image at 2.6x. Cross-check that makes this safe: the 5 left-column values OCR DID keep (1,005 / 392 / 2,830 / PIS=1,933 / 1,770) and ALL 20 right-column values match the image exactly, so the shard's own surviving digits independently confirm the reading. Book spellings preserved: 'Cabernet Suavignon', 'Pomagranate', 'Wolfberry (Gogi)'. Applied out-of-band with corpus_resnap (228 claims: 2 relocated, 0 broken), same reason as Chunk B.

replacements.repl:
Antioxidants:

Daily consumption of antioxidant rich food and drink is a universal feature of those
living in Blue Zones and in particular centenarians. These potent carbon compounds
quench or neutralize free radicals that attack our cells, cell walls, mitochondria and
physiological processes and increase our risk of cardiovascular disease, cancer,
Alzheimer's disease and other dementias, cataracts, diabetes and aggressively speed up
the process and damage of aging itself.

A universally agreed upon method of predicting the antioxidant power and free radical
neutralizing value of foods, drink and supplements is the Oxygen Radical Absorbance
Capacity or ORAC value - based on current studies, we believe that the optimal total
daily intake of ORAC points to reach the age of 100 years is 20,000 to 25,000 per day.

In 2007, scientists with the USDA published an updated list of ORAC values for 277
foods commonly consumed by the U.S. population (fruits, vegetables, nuts, seeds,
spices, grains, drinks, etc.).

ORAC is a method of measuring antioxidant capacities of various foods. It was developed
by scientists at the National Institute on Aging, a division of the National Institute
of Health (NIH) in Baltimore, Maryland and Tufts University, Boston, Massachusetts.

The ORAC analysis, which utilizes Florescein as the florescent probe, provides a
measure of the scavenging capacity of antioxidants against the peroxyl radical, which
is one of the most common reactive oxygen species (ROS) found in the body.

In 2008, the U. S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) listed a database of the ORAC
values. Correlation between the high antioxidant capacity of fruits and vegetables, and
the positive impact of diets high in fruits and vegetables, is well accepted and
universally known to play an important role in the Free-radical theory of aging.

In many countries, of North America, Europe, Asia, Central and South America and their
Blue Zones, the daily consumption of a wide variety of vegetables, fruit, dark berries,
chocolate, wine, coffee and tea are the universal rich cultural sources of antioxidants.

In the "Blue Zones" of the world, large quantities of vitamin C, Beta carotene,
flavanols, lycopenes, leutenes, proanthocyanins, resveratrols, catechens (EGCGs) and
polyphenols are found in dark fruits and berries, yellow and red vegetables, cocoa, red
wine, green tea or coffee - these are the antioxidants that have universally been found
to be consumed daily in the Blue Zones and are known to protect the centenarians.

replacements.why: Chunk B (2026-07-23) — pp.378-379 'Antioxidants:' / the ORAC section. The page is TWO-COLUMN and the OCR interleaved the columns line-by-line, fusing column 2 into the ends of column 1: 'ORAC is a method of measuring antioxidant capacities Cloves, ground 314,446' and '...is the Oxygen Radical Absorbancethe centenarians.' Half the section's sentences were unquotable, which is why the corpus carried no ORAC claim despite this being the richest ORAC passage in all 7 books. Reconstructed against the page image Screenshot (202).png; the IMAGE is the authority wherever it disagrees with the OCR. OCR errors corrected: eaiechene->catechens, EUR-yjtamin->vitamin, iMberries->berries, @entonaniane->Centenarians, '1S 27.'->13,727, TOE->7,904, betweer->between, wel->well, ir->in, bodv->body, 'peroxyl!'->peroxyl, plus junk artifacts (': ,', '> j > > 5c', '_. Ss', '7 5 Hh 5 - fevay,', 'Bo cectofantiocdents'). PRINT spellings deliberately PRESERVED because the page really prints them: Florescein, florescent, catechens, leutenes, proanthocyanins. Peppermint 13,978 is left out of descending order because that is the printed order. APPLIED OUT-OF-BAND (safe_write + corpus_resnap, 228 claims: 2 relocated, 0 healed, 0 broken) because this spec is apply-once and its Chunk-A pass is already baked into the .txt, so it can no longer be re-run end-to-end.

Chunk D (2026-07-23) - orphan OCR fragment 'ee' between the Screenshot (225) marker and the 'Land Mines' heading. Verified against the page image: p.424 runs header ('424  Immortality') straight into the 'Land Mines' heading with no such text; the fragment is scanner noise off the spine shading. Surfaced by mined_pages_clean once the chocolate/ORAC claim made screenshot 225 a MINED page.

replacements.repl:
Chapter 12

"I want to prove that the boundaries (of age) set up by the gods are not unbreakable."

Gilgamesh, King of Sumaria
Clay Tablets, 5000 B.C.

The Common Threads of Anti-Aging

The aging process starts the moment you are conceived and continues unabated,
progressing forward at varying speeds, and degrees at an hourly, daily, weekly and
annual rate until the ultimate end of the process - death.

There is an accumulated knowledge, however, that will allow each of us to prevent and
slow the aging process so that we can successfully reach beyond 100 years of age in a
beautiful, healthful and functional way.

While there are genetic upper limits to human longevity, all humans certainly and
predictably have the genetic potential, the genetic equipment and the genetic capacity
to live well beyond 100! The only reason that all humans don't achieve or reach their
genetic potential for longevity beyond 100 years is that: 1) consciously or
unconsciously, they omit essential pieces of the anti-aging circuitry in their daily
lives necessary to fulfill this potential; and/or 2) they ignorantly or proactively take
pleasure in consciously stepping on land mines.

While the percentage of hundred year olds currently varies from country to country
(Blue Zones), all humans can easily reach 100 years of age by simply following certain
known and predictable physiological laws.

These physiological laws for longevity are as unforgiving and predictable as gravity.
If you step off of the roof of a third story house without a ladder, the law of gravity
will surely take you suddenly and rudely to the ground. If you are unaware of, or simply
ignore the physiological requirements to live to be 100, you will surely not make it to
100 years of age even if you have "good genes."

On the other hand, if everyone in your family died at 35 years of age and you accurately
fulfill your physiological requirements for longevity and you avoid the land mines, you
can easily make it healthfully to 100.

Centenarian Common Threads

A critical examination of the lifestyles and eating habits of the centenarians of the
world's Blue Zones quickly reveals the simple and universal common threads that have
produced and can predictably and repeatedly reproduce 100 year old humans regardless of
genetic makeup, gender, ethnic, religious or national origin.

The omission of any one or any part of the four longevity pieces will result in
catastrophic failure:
replacements.why: Chunk E (2026-07-23) - pp.376-377, the Chapter 12 opening and the ONLY place Wallach names the four longevity pieces. Same two-column fusion as chunks B/C ('...however, thatyeyeals the simple and universal common threads' = left col '...however, that' + right col 'reveals the simple...'). Reading order verified against Screenshot (201).png with both columns read separately at 2.7x: p.376 ends mid-sentence on '...beyond 100 years is' and p.377 continues 'that: 1) consciously or unconsciously...'. OCR fixes: 'Chapter ile'->'Chapter 12', 'a4Q9 year old'->'100 year old', 'w eekly'->'weekly', 'w ay'->'way', '5000 B.C'->'5000 B.C.'. Unblocks the framework that answers 'what raises the ceiling' - antioxidants are ONE of four pieces, minerals are another.
